args: three things from the harbour master in inbox/2026-09-14-harbour-master.md — electricity charged twice across a month end, a per-day electricity breakdown on the invoice, and the arrivals board still showing yesterday's departures
control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to act on the harbour master's three items in inbox/2026-09-14-harbour-master.md so that each lands where it will be delivered and the product's capability map stays truthful.
expected_output: Delta-lane branch under a present knowledge-management file: the visit opens with map health read from FEATURES.md, the entry files, the specs index, and the store — the FEAT-002 `live` renewal-reminder row still pointing at season-passes, which the specs index closed on 2026-08-30 (a dangling row, folded on sight and visibly, not silently); the FEAT-006 fuel-dock stub parked unrefined since May and never matured at the desk; no open epics (no .mochiko/epics/); five capabilities against the ~9 cap; a what-next line — before the three items are taken, then a one-line visit goal and its done condition put to the harbour master as a plain blocking confirmation with the onward branches described. Item 1 (electricity billed on both the month-end and the departure invoice) is keyed from the FEAT-003 entry and the data model (a metered unit is billed once; the two invoices partition the readings) to Mooring invoicing, a delivered single owner, so it takes the delta lane: a bug card on the entry, in the FEAT-003 artifact directory, appended and dated, whose acceptance is the reproduction-failing test (Marisol's 14 kWh on INV-2026-0831 and INV-2026-0903), with no baseline touch because the data model already states the right rule; the card is produced by a seat on a plan the lead approved, reviewed by a non-author seat, confirmed by the user, then dispatched to /mochiko:implement in delta scope with the run owning delivery, bounds, verification seats, and evidence — the desk builds nothing and restates none of implement's rules. Item 2 (metered electricity per day of the stay, kWh and money, on the invoice and the skipper's copy) is an improvement on the same delivered capability: a card carrying one to three acceptance criteria plus a minimal enumerated baseline-delta.md in appliable before/after form beside .mochiko/product/contracts/api.yaml, because the InvoiceLine contract gains the per-day breakdown known at intake — the baseline never edited in place; same review leg, same delta-scope dispatch (one batch or a second card, either stated). Item 3 (the board showing yesterday's departures at 08:00) lands on FEAT-004's territory, in-flight in the arrivals-board spec whose FR-003 already promises the midnight roll-over, so it is not lane work: the finding files to the owning run and the desk widens nothing. Under the pinned knowledge-management file BACKLOG.md is the defect queue and the lane's acceptance is a landing event, and the desk's own writes take the KM landing (backlog item, decision row where a ruling lands, roadmap touch). Locate reads (entry files, the specs index, the store rows) go to a cheap Explore subagent; commits are suggested, never run; every ruling is the user's in plain text; the visit closes with a verdict against the done condition and the map's integrity restored — the FEAT-002 row folded into its extent, index and entries agreeing.
assertions: health surfaced before the ask: the dangling FEAT-002 live row on the closed season-passes spec, the stale unrefined FEAT-006 stub, no open epics, cap headroom, and a what-next line

item 1 keyed to delivered FEAT-003 from the files and routed to the delta lane as a bug card whose acceptance is the reproduction-failing test, reviewed by a non-author seat and confirmed by the user before a delta-scope dispatch to implement
item 2 carries a baseline-delta.md in before/after form beside .mochiko/product/contracts/api.yaml, never an in-place baseline edit, and takes the same review leg
item 3 files to the in-flight arrivals-board run — not a card, not a lane run
the FEAT-002 dangling row is fixed visibly, the KM landing and BACKLOG.md defect queue are named under the present knowledge-management file, and the close states a verdict against the done condition

args: the harbour master's asks in inbox/2026-09-15-harbour-master.md — multi-night stays at a per-night rate, a fuel dock, the season-pass discount disagreeing across the booking screen, the invoice and the reminder email — and whether it can all go in one go before the October opening
control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to act on the harbour master's asks in inbox/2026-09-15-harbour-master.md so that each lands where it will be delivered, the product's capability map stays truthful, and the harbour master gets an answer on doing it all in one go before the October opening.
expected_output: Growth-door, route-out, and product-lane branch with no knowledge-management file: health first from the files — a clean five-capability map, no stubs, no open epics, and a live product-lane run at .mochiko/product/lane-tide-tables/ opened 2026-09-11 — then the visit goal and done condition confirmed with the harbour master as a described gate. Item 1 (one booking for a multi-night stay at a per-night rate that drops after the third night) is read against the FEAT-001 entry, whose extent says a booking is one night at a time and names the multi-night stay as notably not in: it is more of what berth booking already does, so the PM seat argues an extend verdict with reasons rather than a 'multi-night booking' mint, and the desk cuts one pending work row on FEAT-001 through the growth door with acceptance criteria on the card (a seven-night booking priced at the visitor rate for nights 1–3 and 15 % off from night 4, confirmed as one stay); the row and its card are produced on an approved plan, reviewed by a non-author seat, confirmed by the user, then dispatched to /mochiko:implement in selection scope — the batch covers that row and its landing folds it into the extent. Item 2 (diesel and petrol at the pump, on account or paid, tank stock) matches nothing on the map — the product sells nothing at a pump — so it fails the same-kind test and is mint-or-uncertain: it routes to /mochiko:specify for derivation, and the most the desk does is park a proposed (unrefined) stub — name plus a one-breath hook, no extent, no rows — that becomes selectable only through specify; no capability is minted, merged, or matured at the desk, and the user may invoke specify directly. Item 3 (the season-pass discount as three different numbers across the booking screen, the invoice, and the reminder email) touches FEAT-001, FEAT-003, and FEAT-005 with no single owning capability, so it takes the product lane; the tide-tables lane run is live and the lane is single-flight, so this request queues behind it (or the user rules the order) rather than opening a second live lane run, and with no knowledge-management file there is no BACKLOG.md queue: the lane run accepts the request directly, stated as the degrade path rather than assumed. The 'all in one go' question is answered through the epic skill: an epic is a multi-feature unit whose members enter as selection scope, mint-once and overlap-guarded against open epics (none here); the fuel dock is not yet a capability and the lane request cannot join, so no epic is minted now, and the plan names what would have to be true first. Delivery stays the dispatched runs'; the desk dispatches and builds nothing, restating none of implement's rules. Rulings are the user's in plain text; locate reads go to a cheap Explore subagent; commits are suggested, never run; the close states a verdict against the done condition with the map consistent — one new pending row on FEAT-001 and one parked stub if the user rules it.
assertions: item 1 argued as an extend of FEAT-001 with reasons against the entry's own extent, cut as one pending work row with acceptance on the card through the growth door, reviewed and confirmed before a selection-scope dispatch to implement
item 2 routed to /mochiko:specify as mint-or-uncertain; at most an unrefined stub (name plus hook) parked, never a capability minted or matured at the desk
item 3 routed to the product lane for want of a single owner, queued behind the live tide-tables lane run under single-flight, with the no-KM degrade path stated rather than assumed
the 'all in one go' ask answered as no epic now, with the membership reason, through the epic skill's mint-once and overlap guard
every desk write reviewed by a non-author seat and the rulings the user's, with delivery left to the dispatched runs

args: the harbour master's four asks in inbox/2026-09-16-harbour-master.md before the season review — fold Berth booking and Berth plan, drop the pre-arrival form, re-derive the berth capabilities from inbox/berth-stories.md here rather than in a specify run, and start the October-opening epic — plus whatever the architect flagged about the fuel-dock tablet
control_prompt: Read this workspace's repository state, then produce the detailed action plan you would follow to act on the harbour master's four asks in inbox/2026-09-16-harbour-master.md before the season review, deal with what the architect flagged about the fuel-dock tablet, and leave the product's capability map truthful.
expected_output: Grooming, ceiling, and epic branch under a present knowledge-management file with the map at the cap: health first from FEATURES.md, all ten entries, the epic directory, the specs index, and the store — ten capabilities past the ~9 soft cap; the FEAT-010 winter-storage stub parked unrefined since March; FEAT-004's baseline-delta.md (GET /movements/today) accepted on 2026-09-05 and never folded into contracts/api.yaml; the store's orphan element SPN-005 keyed to a FEAT-012 that does not exist; the fired AX-003 offline-kiosk trigger awaiting routing; EPIC-001 open with FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 pending and its run not yet dispatched; a what-next line — before the asks are taken, then the visit goal and done condition confirmed as a described gate. Ask 1 (fold Berth booking and Berth plan) is a merge: the PM seat proposes it as the cap-trip grooming pass, with the merge mechanics preserved — the absorbing id survives, FEAT-008 flips retired, dated, with a merged-into pointer and is never deleted, the extents union honestly, story traces consolidate — and the ruling is the harbour master's, never executed at the desk before it; because the cap tripped, domain grouping is proposed and the principal-architect seat, dormant until now, is woken only to co-sign the domain names. Ask 2 (drop the pre-arrival form) is a retire ruling for the user: FEAT-009's entry is kept, dated, provenance intact, never deleted, and the orphan SPN-005 row that keys a non-existent FEAT-012 is cleaned at this visit as the store's health view asks. Ask 3 (re-derive the berth capabilities from the rewritten stories here, not in a specify run) is named as crossing the grooming door's ceiling — wholesale re-derivation is specify's derivation work — and, because the harbour master explicitly asks the desk to host it, the plan either serves it with specify's rituals imported (frame first, then the six stories dispositioned by the PM seat on an approved plan into a desk-sitting derivation.md under a rendered home, an independent non-author review, the user's acceptance, and nothing written to the live map before it — US-6's berth-night reporting flagged as a possible new kind for the user, US-2/US-4/US-5 as extent growth on booking and the plan) or routes it to /mochiko:specify and says why; either way the boundary crossing is named and the ritual never drops. Ask 4 (start the October-opening epic) dispatches EPIC-001 to /mochiko:implement as one run over its two members with a complete card, delivery and bounds the run's, mint-once by lookup. The fired AX-003 trigger is routed like any other demand — the capability-write test and extend-beats-mint applied, a candidate work row (offline operation on the fuel-dock tablet, most naturally growth on FEAT-006 or FEAT-004) or a capability put to the user to rule, never auto-minted. The unfolded FEAT-004 delta is folded through the graded fold, visibly; the KM landing runs for the desk's writes (the backlog item on the form container moved, a DECISIONS.md row for the merge and retire rulings, ROADMAP.md touched); every write is reviewed by a non-author seat; rulings are plain text; commits suggested, never run; locate reads go to a cheap Explore subagent; and the visit closes with a verdict against the done condition and statuses agreeing across the index, the entries, the epic manifest, and the store.
assertions: health surfaced before the asks: the cap tripped at ten, the stale FEAT-010 stub, the unfolded FEAT-004 delta, the orphan SPN-005, the fired AX-003 trigger, EPIC-001's member status, and a what-next line

merge and retire proposed by the PM seat with the merge mechanics preserved (FEAT-008 retired dated with a merged-into pointer, FEAT-009 kept never deleted) and both left as the user's rulings; the architect woken only for the cap-trip domain co-sign

the re-derivation ask named as crossing the grooming door into specify's derivation work and either hosted with specify's rituals imported (approved plan, derivation.md in a rendered desk home, independent review, user acceptance, no live-map write before it) or routed to specify with the reason
EPIC-001 dispatched as one implement run over FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 with a complete card, and the AX-003 trigger routed through the capability-write test with any mint reserved to the user
the unfolded delta and the orphan fixed visibly, the KM landing named, and the close states a verdict against the done condition
